Regulation FD Disclosure. On November 18, 2026, in connection with its Investor Day, McGraw Hill, Inc. (the “Company”) issued a press release outlining its long-term strategy and multi-year financial framework, including financial targets. A copy of the Company’s press release is attached hereto as Exhibit 99.1. The Company will host its Investor Day beginning at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time today, which will be live-webcast and archived on the Company’s Investor Relations website. To access the webcast and corresponding slide presentation, visit https://mheducation2026investorday.q4ir.com . In accordance with General Instruction B.2 of Form 8-K, the information under this Item 7.01, including Exhibit 99.1, is being furnished to the Commission, but shall not be deemed “filed” with the Commission for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the “Exchange Act”), or otherwise subject to the liabilities of that section, nor shall such information, including Exhibit 99.1, be deemed incorporated by reference into any filing under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, or the Exchange Act, regardless of any general incorporation language in such filing, unless expressly incorporated by reference in such filing.
